literal_meaning: অন্য বিশেষ (other particulars or minor distinctions)
figurative_meaning_bn: অন্য থেকে পার্থক্য; কমবেশি প্রভেদ; সামান্য পার্থক্য
figurative_meaning_en: difference from others; more or less distinction; slight difference
similar_in_english: six of one and half a dozen of the other
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই দুটি পদ্ধতির মধ্যে কোনো ইতরবিশেষ নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: There is no difference between the two.
There is no significant difference between these two methods.
note: This idiom emphasizes negligible differences, commonly used in colloquial Bengali to dismiss minor variations.
